notes.title: White Rabbit's Diary - Major Update with Voice Acting and additional Art!!!
notes.notes: Announcing the re-release of White Rabbit: Royal Scheduler as Wonderland Nights: White Rabbit's Diary, now with full voice acting, new pieces of art for endings, and a number of quality updates. Enjoy! Find us on instagram or Facebook under Sky Bear Games to see the actor profiles coming out over the next couple of weeks.
